_note: Bloc proposals, V1.3d. Shaped after the real Stability and Growth Pact and the Excessive Deficit Procedure, but the numbers are game numbers set by tools/bloc_probe.gd and not by the Treaties -- see docs/bloc-model.md. File order is the council's agenda: src/sim/bloc.gd rotates an index over the loaded list, so a proposal added here changes what comes up and when.

proposals.name: Stability and Growth Pact
proposals.summary: Members undertake to hold the general government deficit under 3% of GDP. The Commission reports on those who do not, and the Council may levy a penalty.

proposals.name: Debt Reduction Rule
proposals.summary: A member carrying debt above 90% of GDP commits to a path back below it. The path is not enforced; the reporting is.

proposals.name: Minimum Corporate Rate
proposals.summary: A floor under corporation tax across the bloc, so that no member can compete for headquarters by cutting below it.
